categories.label: RESOURCES
categories._comment: 7 action types: add_gold, add_food, add_milk, add_orbs, give_item, give_blueprint, give_prop

buttons.label: GET ITEM
buttons._comment: give_item: item_type is game item enum, data is sub-id, level is tier

buttons.label: GET BLUEPRINT
buttons._comment: give_blueprint: h_type = cell to unlock. fragment:true = single piece (need 3), lvl = pip display

buttons.label: GET PROP
buttons._comment: give_prop: unlocks a prop in customization menu by prop_id

categories.label: MONSTERS
categories._comment: 5 action types: spawn_mon, set_troop_level, add_troop_exp, set_skill_level, set_troop_size

buttons.label: SPAWN GOBLIN
buttons._comment: spawn_mon: species 0=goblin 1=hobgoblin 2=tentacle 3=ogre

buttons.label: TROOP LVL 10
buttons._comment: set_troop_level: sets lvl for one goblin class of one species

buttons.label: +500 TROOP EXP
buttons._comment: add_troop_exp: adds exp to one goblin class of one species

buttons.label: SKILL LVL 5
buttons._comment: set_skill_level: sets skill level for one goblin class of one species

buttons.label: TROOP SIZE 5
buttons._comment: set_troop_size: sets max troop size (0-7)

categories.label: UNITS
categories._comment: 2 action types: create_unit, create_unit_cage. NOTE: class_id must be numeric (no string ref resolution in tool actions)

buttons.label: ADD PEASANT
buttons._comment: create_unit: spawns a free unit. class_id is numeric (0=peasant, 1=cleric, etc.)

buttons.label: CAGE KNIGHT
buttons._comment: create_unit_cage: spawns a caged unit

categories.label: UNLOCKS
categories._comment: 7 action types: unlock_boss, unlock_stage_next, unlock_breeds, unlock_cell, unlock_prop, unlock_raid, unlock_all_cells

buttons.label: UNLOCK BOSS 0
buttons._comment: unlock_boss: index 0-4 (vanilla boss slots)

buttons.label: NEXT STAGE
buttons._comment: unlock_stage_next: stage 0-3

buttons.label: UNLOCK CELL 1
buttons._comment: unlock_cell: h_type must be numeric (no string ref resolution)

buttons.label: UNLOCK RAID
buttons._comment: unlock_raid: enables raid button (no parameters)

buttons.label: DEBUG OVERLAY
buttons._comment: show_debug_overlay: optional 'enable' field (default true)

categories.label: GENERIC
categories._comment: 2 action types: set_val (16 allowlisted keys), set_var (1 allowlisted key: w_spd)

buttons.label: MAX MOOD
buttons._comment: set_val: allowlisted keys: mood, food, money, cart_spd, add_range, day, day_timer, orb_num, sfx_vol, bgm_vol, alpha_type, mon_alpha, crate_alpha_type, crate_alpha, show_head, censor

buttons.label: WORLD SPD 3
buttons._comment: set_var: allowlisted key: w_spd

categories.label: STATE & META
categories._comment: 6 action types: set_state, set_continuous, fire_event, fire_trigger, popup, play_sfx

buttons.label: MOOD LOCK
buttons._comment: set_continuous: key = effect name (only 'mood_lock' implemented), value = true/false. Toggle string = save_state key.

buttons.label: RESET QUEST
buttons._comment: set_state: writes to mod save_state field

buttons.label: FIRE WITCH INTRO
buttons._comment: fire_event: directly fires a named event from quests.json

buttons.label: CHECK TRIGGERS
buttons._comment: fire_trigger: re-evaluates all triggers for a given hook

buttons.label: TEST POPUP
buttons._comment: popup: shows a named popup from quests.json popups

buttons.label: DING SFX
buttons._comment: play_sfx: plays a sound effect

buttons.label: FULL RESET
buttons._comment: === Multiple actions in one button ===

keybinds._modifiers: Valid modifiers: none / shift / ctrl / alt
